questions.q: A bariatric surgery patient (Roux-en-Y gastric bypass) complains of 'Dumping Syndrome' (dizziness, sweating, diarrhea) after eating. Which dietary error most likely caused this?
options: Consuming concentrated sweets or simple sugars.
questions.explain: Dumping syndrome occurs when simple sugars rapidly enter the small intestine, drawing fluid in. Avoiding concentrated sweets prevents this.
